title: Fredy Market & Operations
description: Berlin rental market models: fair-price map, best-priced listings, market timelines, and model health.

panels.title: Market at a glance and price map
Fair-price surface and current listings
panels.description: The polygon surface is the Ridge baseline fair price. Listing points follow the selected model and are colored by price delta: green is below fair, red is above fair.

panels.title: Listing density — comps per ~500m cell
panels.description: How many comparable flats feed the model around each grid cell. Thin areas mean low confidence.

panels.title: Top 5 — last 24h
panels.description: Active listings first seen in the last 24h, ranked by price vs model fair price. Click a title to open the listing.

panels.title: Daily €/m² — p25, median, p75 (cold-rent basis)
panels.description: Asking €/m² of unique flats first seen each day. The shaded envelope spans the 25th to 75th percentile; composition changes still matter.

panels.title: Daily new listings by provider (main jobs)
panels.description: Scraper health: a provider flatlining means its scrape is broken or bot-blocked.

panels.title: Median €/m²: asking vs model fair (accumulates from deploy)
Mispricing distribution (visible flats, delta % vs fair)
panels.description: A fattening left tail = more underpriced supply.

panels.title: Cross-validation MdAPE
panels.description: Median absolute percentage error from the current model's out-of-sample cross-validation. Lower is better.

panels.title: CV within ±10%
panels.description: Share of out-of-sample predictions within ten percent of the observed rent.

panels.title: Interval coverage
panels.description: Observed coverage of the conformal prediction interval. Higher is better up to the configured target.

panels.title: Naive MdAPE (floor)
panels.description: Error of always predicting the global median. The model must beat this.

panels.title: Training corpus
panels.description: unique = deduped flats trained on; raw_rows = before dedupe; swap_excluded = Tauschwohnung listings dropped.

panels.title: Database schema
panels.description: Every migration shipped in the running Fredy image must be applied.

panels.title: Rating queue
panels.description: Pending, retrying, processing, or waiting for a compatible market model.
